workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.how_agent_handles_readback: The agent correlates request id, idempotency key, payload hash, workflow, and lane before summarizing.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.how_missing_or_stale_readbacks_are_handl: Missing and stale readbacks are explained plainly and fail closed.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.how_operator_sees_status: The operator sees plain cards such as Waiting, Ready for review, Stale, Blocked, or Duplicate no-op.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.how_truth_is_confirmed: Truth comes from a matched, fresh readback or proof receipt. No readback means no success claim.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.next_safe_move: Use the ready card to ask the operator whether the Capital Hilton understanding looks right.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.plain_summary: The concierge keeps track of the request/readback loop so the operator does not have to hunt for backend files.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.what_this_does_not_do_yet: It does not poll, watch folders, dispatch agents, run workflows, call models, or perform external actions.
workflow_readback_concierge_elioperator_.what_this_enables: An active surface can say whether a request is waiting, ready, stale, blocked, duplicate, or missing.
